newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - CIC DOMINATES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - CIC DOMINATES TRADE.

text.p: packaging group CIC Holdings dominated trade on the Namibian
Stock Exchange last week with 4.5 million shares changing hands
CIC stock moved up from N$2.95 to N$3.10.
The total value of dealing across the market was N$23.6
million for a volume of 5.61 million shares.
The NSE overall index closed at 254.46, up from the previous
week's 251.58. But the local index dipped to 164.77 from 165.37,
